guidance.summary: The 161-day lockout and a compressed 66-game season
Chris Paul trade to the Lakers vetoed; Paul lands with the Clippers
LeBron wins MVP and his first title
Jeremy Lin takes over New York
Dwight Howard saga in Orlando ends with Van Gundy and Smith out
Finals: Heat beat the Thunder 4-1; LeBron James Finals MVP
Heat: beat NYK 4-1, IND 4-2, BOS 4-3, OKC 4-1 (champion)
Thunder: beat DAL 4-0, LAL 4-1, SAS 4-2; lost Finals to MIA 1-4
Celtics: beat ATL 4-2, PHI 4-3; lost to MIA 3-4
Spurs: swept UTA and LAC; lost to OKC 2-4
Pacers: beat ORL 4-1; lost to MIA 2-4
76ers: beat CHI 4-2; lost to BOS 3-4
Lakers: beat DEN 4-3; lost to OKC 1-4
Clippers: beat MEM 4-3; swept by SAS
Bulls: lost to PHI 2-4 after Rose tears his ACL
Knicks: lost to MIA 1-4
Magic: lost to IND 1-4 without Howard
Hawks: lost to BOS 2-4
Jazz: swept by SAS
Mavericks: swept by OKC
Nuggets: lost to LAL 3-4
Grizzlies: lost to LAC 3-4
MVP: LeBron James
Rookie of the Year: Kyrie Irving
Defensive Player of the Year: Tyson Chandler
Most Improved Player: Ryan Anderson
Sixth Man of the Year: James Harden
Coach of the Year: Gregg Popovich
Post-lockout free agency: Chandler, West, Nene
March 15 deadline: Bogut-Ellis, Nene-McGee, Wallace to the Nets, Fisher traded, Howard opts in
Coaching changes: Westphal, Saunders, D'Antoni, McMillan midseason; Van Gundy and Silas after
Hornets, then owned by the league, win the 2012 lottery
Anthony Davis No. 1, Kidd-Gilchrist No. 2, Beal No. 3
Horford pectoral, Garnett series, Ferry hired
Jeff Green heart surgery, aging core reaches East finals
Deron 57, Wallace trade, last New Jersey game

Nene re-signed then traded for McGee, Lakers series
Frank hired, Drummond drafted

CP3 veto, Lowry-McHale friction
West signs, third seed, Bird steps down
Chris Paul arrives, Billups Achilles, Game 7 win
CP3 veto, Odom traded, Fisher traded, Metta elbow
Randolph MCL, Clippers series
LeBron MVP and first title
Bogut traded for Ellis
Adelman hired, Love extension, Rubio ACL
Paul traded, league ownership, Benson buys, Davis No. 1
